subject: Audit logs & data access — export formats and retention (post-demo follow-up)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Maya Chen <maya.chen@fincobank.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fincobank.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Audit logs & data access — export formats and retention (post-demo follow-up)

Maya / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and next steps so we’re aligned: 

What we heard (summary)
- Need: per-user access/audit logs showing who accessed what/when for LLM endpoints (including model id, request id, and prompt hash).
- Export formats: CSV preferred for initial review, Parquet/JSON for SIEM ingestion.
- Retention: regulatory ask is 7 years for a subset of events; otherwise rolling retention configurable.
- PII handling: prefer hashed or token-redacted inputs in audit logs, with the ability to provide hashed/full for eDiscovery under access controls.
- Ingestion: want options for SFTP push or direct S3/Splunk ingestion to your SIEM.

Proposed next steps
1) I’ll coordinate a technical response with our solutions engineer (Dev) to confirm schema, export options, and retention capabilities — target: deliver a sample export and schema by Thu (7/16).
2) Maya — can you confirm the exact service account(s) / scope you need for the 90-day evidence pull (e.g., svc_account:fincobank-prod)?
3) If acceptable, we’ll schedule a tech validation call next week to walk through the sample export and ingestion.

Attachments: I will share our audit log schema and a small sample export in the follow-up from Dev.

Thanks — Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Maya Chen <maya.chen@fincobank.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fincobank.com>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@fincobank.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T17:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit logs & data access — export formats and retention (post-demo follow-up)

Thanks Dylan — appreciated the recap. A few clarifying items from the compliance side: 

- Required fields: user_id, timestamp (ISO8601), action (read/write/admin), resource (API endpoint/model id), request_id, prompt_hash, response_id, client_ip, session_id, and any applied redaction flag.
- Export formats: we need CSV for quick review but must support Parquet/JSON for downstream processing in our data lake.
- Retention: legal is requesting 7 years for audit events tied to production payment flows. Please confirm whether Redwood can support 7-year retention (or export/archive on our behalf).
- PII: we cannot have full raw prompts stored unredacted for production payment traffic. We need to know whether Redwood can provide hashed prompt representations (SHA-256 or equivalent) and/or token-level redaction before logs are written.
- SIEM ingestion: confirmation needed that you can push to SFTP/S3 or integrate with Splunk/Datadog.
- Evidence request: we will need a one-time export of the last 90 days for svc_account:fincobank-prod (scope: all request/response audit events) in CSV and Parquet. Please confirm ETA and what access controls/log filters will be applied.

Appreciate a technical reply and a sample export to validate.

--
Maya Chen
Head of Compliance, FinCo Bank
maya.chen@fincobank.com
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Maya Chen <maya.chen@fincobank.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fincobank.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit logs & data access — export formats and retention (technical details & sample)

On Jul 12, 2026, at 3:02 PM, dylan.brooks@redwood.com wrote:
> Maya / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and next steps so we’re aligned:

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. Technical answers below plus attachments and a sample export link.

1) Schema and fields (we capture the following audit event fields):
- event_id
- timestamp (ISO8601)
- principal_id (user_id or service account)
- principal_type (user/service_account)
- action (generate, embed, admin, config_change)
- resource (model_id, endpoint_id)
- request_id / response_id
- prompt_hash (SHA-256)
- prompt_redaction_flag (none/partial/full)
- client_ip
- geo_location (derived)
- user_agent
- session_id
- bytes_in / bytes_out
- export_id (if part of an export job)

2) Export formats & ingestion
- Formats: CSV, newline-delimited JSON (ndjson), and Parquet.
- Delivery: we can produce on-demand exports (CSV/Parquet) and/or push to your S3 bucket or SFTP endpoint. We also support Splunk HEC and Datadog ingestion via our integration layer.

3) Retention & residency
- Retention: configurable per-customer via the Console. Defaults: 365 days. We support extended retention tiers - 3 years, 7 years (enterprise/compliance plan). For 7-year retention we can either keep the logs in-region under your account or provide periodic exported archives to your S3.
- Residency: logs are stored in the region you select for your account (US/EU/APAC). If you require in-region-only storage for the 7-year archive, we can arrange S3 vaulting to your account.

4) PII and redaction options
- We support configurable redaction policies:
  a) full prompt hashing (SHA-256) — only hash stored in audit logs;
  b) token-level redaction per regex/PII classifier — redacted text stored;
  c) raw prompt storage (not recommended for payment flows) — available only under strict contractual controls.
- For eDiscovery we can provide secured extracts with team-based access controls and audit trails.

5) Evidence export for svc_account:fincobank-prod
- We can provide the last 90 days of events for svc_account:fincobank-prod. Delivery options: CSV + Parquet via S3 or SFTP. Estimated delivery: Thu 2026-07-16 EOD (subject to approved access request & DPA addendum for extended retention).

Attachments included:
- rdw_audit_log_schema.pdf (schema and field descriptions)
- sample export available at: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRDW-fincobank (csv and ndjson examples)

If you confirm the service account and delivery method (S3 vs SFTP), I’ll kick off the export job and share the signed access link. Happy to walk through this during a tech validation session — propose Tue 7/21 or Wed 7/22.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

Thanks Dev — that level of detail is helpful. Confirming:
- Service account: svc_account:fincobank-prod (please include all roles).
- Delivery: S3 push to our staging bucket (we will share bucket + write creds via secure channel).
- Required fields: please ensure client_ip and prompt_hash are present in the export.
- Retention: we will request 7-year retention for payment flows; please flag the DPA/contact for the legal team so we can formalize.
- ETA: Thu 7/16 EOD works for the initial 90-day export. Please include both CSV and Parquet.

Next steps:
1) Dev to initiate export and share secure S3 transfer details.
2) Dylan to schedule a tech validation call for Tue 7/21 (we prefer 10:00–11:00 PST).
3) FinCo compliance will circulate the DPA/retention addendum template for review.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.
